description: This file defines the Category class within the Goteo project, representing project categories with methods for retrieval, validation, persistence, and querying category data.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Represents a project category with properties such as id, name, description, social commitment, and usage metrics, including methods for database operations and data validation.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the list of database fields that are language-dependent ('name' and 'description').

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific category by id, optionally for a specific language, returning an instance of the Category class.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all categories with additional metadata such as number of associated projects and users, ordered by a specified order.

methods.name: getNames
methods.description: Returns an associative array of category IDs and their names for categories used in published projects, with optional language specification.

methods.name: getSocialCommitment
methods.description: Fetches and returns the SocialCommitment object associated with this category.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the category instance, primarily checking if the 'name' property is set; returns true if valid, false otherwise.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the category to the database after validation; returns true on success or false with errors.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Reorders the category to move it up in the order.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Reorders the category to move it down in the order.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Calculates and returns the next order position for a new category.

methods.name: getKeyWords
methods.description: Retrieves a list of distinct keywords from projects, optionally filtered by a search term, limited to a specified number.
